description_en: Retrieves the parameters for a trial voice conversation
description_zh: 获取试用语音对话参数
name: GetTrialDataChannelCredential

parameters.help_en: The instance identity of the associated product. You must use an existing instance that the invoker has access to. The instance must be consistent with the instance to which the scenario, channel, and session belong. The maximum length is subject to the current POP parameter definition
parameters.help_zh: 所属产品的实例标识。必须使用调用者有权访问且确实存在的实例；应与场景、渠道和会话所属实例保持一致。最大长度以当前POP参数定义为准
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the client device that initiates web voice calls or receives data channel events. The same client must use the same DeviceId when retrieving data channel credentials and initiating calls. The example is only a business device ID and not a real credential assigned by the platform
parameters.help_zh: 标识发起网页语音或接收数据通道事件的客户端设备。同一客户端获取数据通道凭证和发起呼叫时应使用相同的DeviceId；示例仅为业务设备标识，不是平台分配的真实凭证
parameters.name: device_id

parameters.help_en: The visitor token obtained from the trial link. It is used to locate the trial channel and verify access permissions and validity periods. The token is generated by the channel service and must not be constructed manually. It cannot be empty and must still be valid. The example is a placeholder value that cannot be used for authentication. Do not disclose real tokens to unauthorized personnel
parameters.help_zh: 从体验链接取得的访客令牌，用于定位试用渠道并校验访问权限和有效期。令牌由渠道服务生成，不应自行构造；不能为空，且必须仍在有效期内。示例为不可用于认证的占位值，请勿将真实令牌泄露给无关人员
parameters.name: visitor_token

schema.description_en: The business response of this API operation. A Code value of OK indicates success, and Data contains the corresponding business result. For business errors, troubleshoot by using Message and Params
schema.description_zh: 本次API的业务响应，Code=OK表示成功，Data为对应业务结果；业务错误结合Message及Params排查

Code.description_en: The business processing status code. OK indicates success. When an exception occurs, the corresponding business error code is returned. The error types and mapping rules follow the current API configuration. No error codes are added or modified in this operation
Code.description_zh: 业务处理状态码，OK表示成功；发生异常时返回对应的业务错误码。错误类型和映射规则沿用当前API配置，本次不新增或修改错误码

Data.description_en: The data channel connection and authentication information for the specified device. Use the actual return values and do not deduce topics or credentials manually
Data.description_zh: 指定设备的数据通道连接与认证信息。使用实际返回值，勿自行推导主题或凭证

ClientId.description_en: The client connection ID returned by the data channel service. It must be used together with the address, username, and password returned in this response. The example is a desensitized placeholder value and does not declare a fixed naming rule
ClientId.description_zh: 数据通道服务返回的客户端连接标识，应与本次返回的地址、用户名和密码配套使用；示例为脱敏占位值，不声明固定命名规则

DeviceId.description_en: The ID of the client device that initiates web voice calls or receives data channel events. The same client must use the same DeviceId when retrieving data channel credentials and initiating calls. The example is only a business device ID and not a real credential assigned by the platform
DeviceId.description_zh: 标识发起网页语音或接收数据通道事件的客户端设备。同一客户端获取数据通道凭证和发起呼叫时应使用相同的DeviceId；示例仅为业务设备标识，不是平台分配的真实凭证

Endpoint.description_en: The access endpoint of the data channel. The actual address, protocol, port, and authentication method are subject to the return values of the RTC gateway and client conventions. Local code only delegates to the gateway service and cannot be used to confirm a fixed production domain name or MQTT/WebSocket protocol
Endpoint.description_zh: 数据通道的接入端点。实际地址、协议、端口和认证方式以RTC网关返回和客户端约定为准；本地代码仅委托网关服务，不能据此确认固定生产域名或MQTT/WebSocket协议

ExpirationTime.description_en: The expiration time of the temporary credentials for the data channel. The current POP maps to expirationTime, while the local RTC second-party package field is expiredTime. The field mapping compatibility and time unit must be verified against the actual gateway version. Do not assume that the field is always returned or interpret it as milliseconds without authorization. The example only demonstrates the integer format
ExpirationTime.description_zh: 数据通道临时凭证的过期时间。当前POP映射expirationTime，本地RTC二方包字段为expiredTime，字段映射兼容性及时间单位需核实实际网关版本。不要假设字段必定返回或擅自按毫秒解释；示例仅演示整数形式

Password.description_en: The temporary authentication password used to connect to the data channel. It must be used together with UserName and within the validity period. It is a sensitive credential and the real value must not be disclosed. The example is a placeholder value that cannot be used for authentication
Password.description_zh: 连接数据通道所使用的临时认证密码，应与UserName配套使用并在有效期内使用。属于敏感凭证，不得公开真实值；示例为不可用于认证的占位值

Topic.description_en: The topic ID returned by the data channel service. The client subscribes to or receives events based on the actual protocol and this topic. The client must not deduce the topic based on DeviceId or treat the example as a real available topic
Topic.description_zh: 数据通道服务返回的主题标识。客户端按实际协议和该主题订阅或接收事件；不得根据DeviceId自行推导主题，也不把示例当成真实可用主题

UserName.description_en: The temporary authentication username used to connect to the data channel. It must be used together with the Password and Endpoint returned in the same response. The example placeholder value cannot be used for logon
UserName.description_zh: 连接数据通道所使用的临时认证用户名。应与同次返回的Password及Endpoint配套使用，不能将示例占位值用于登录

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code recorded in the business response body. A normal return value is 200. To determine whether the business operation is successful, you must also check Code. You cannot determine the success of the call solely based on the presence of this field
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: 业务响应体记录的HTTP状态码，正常返回为200。判断业务是否成功还应检查Code，不能仅凭该字段存在认定调用成功

Message.description_en: The business response or error description. It is usually empty or not returned upon success, and no fixed text is returned upon success. Upon failure, it provides an error description to assist in troubleshooting. Combine it with Code and Params to understand the cause of the error. The example is an error message when the trial link visitor token expires (corresponding to the Code Expired.VisitorToken) and is for format reference only
Message.description_zh: 业务响应或错误说明。成功时通常为空或不返回，不能要求成功时固定返回某段文本；失败时为错误说明，用于辅助排查，并结合Code与Params理解错误原因。示例为体验链接访客令牌过期时的错误消息（对应Code为Expired.VisitorToken），仅作格式参考

Params.description_en: The list of parameters used for the localized display of error messages. It is not a scenario variable or business result. A normal successful response is usually an empty array. When an error occurs, parameters corresponding to the error template may be returned
Params.description_zh: 用于错误消息本地化展示的参数列表，不是场景变量或业务结果。正常成功响应通常为空数组；出现错误时可能返回与错误模板对应的参数

items.description_en: A parameter value in the error message template. The specific content is determined by the current error. The example InstanceId only demonstrates a possible field name and does not indicate that this value is returned for every call
items.description_zh: 错误消息模板中的一个参数值。具体内容由本次错误决定；示例InstanceId仅演示可能的字段名，不表示每次调用均返回该值

RequestId.description_en: The ID used to correlate and troubleshoot this POP request. The value in the response corresponds to this request. System request parameters are injected by the gateway, and the caller does not need to fill in system fields
RequestId.description_zh: 用于关联和排查本次POP请求的标识。响应中的值对应本次请求；系统请求参数由网关注入，调用者不需要自行填写系统字段
